rows.question: How many days of paid annual leave do I get each year?
rows.answer: Every full-time employee gets 24 days of paid annual leave per calendar year. [employee_handbook_excerpt.md] Employees get 10 days of paid sick leave per year. [leave_policy.md]

rows.question: How many unused leave days can I carry over to next year?
rows.answer: Employees can carry over a maximum of 5 unused days into the next calendar year. [employee_handbook_excerpt.md]

rows.question: How many days of paid sick leave are there?
rows.answer: Employees get 10 days of paid sick leave per year. [leave_policy.md] A medical certificate is required if sick leave runs for more than 2 consecutive days. [leave_policy.md] Every full-time employee gets 24 days of paid annual leave per calendar year. [employee_handbook_excerpt.md]

rows.question: When do I need a medical certificate for sick leave?
rows.answer: A medical certificate is required if sick leave runs for more than 2 consecutive days. [leave_policy.md]

rows.question: How long is parental leave for the primary caregiver?
rows.answer: The primary caregiver gets 16 weeks of paid parental leave. [leave_policy.md] The secondary caregiver gets 6 weeks of paid parental leave. [leave_policy.md]

rows.question: How many weeks of parental leave does the secondary caregiver get?
rows.answer: The secondary caregiver gets 6 weeks of paid parental leave. [leave_policy.md] The primary caregiver gets 16 weeks of paid parental leave. [leave_policy.md]

rows.question: How far in advance must I submit a leave request?
rows.answer: Leave requests are submitted through the HR portal at least 5 working days in advance. [leave_policy.md]

rows.question: Who has to approve unpaid leave?
rows.answer: Unpaid leave of any length needs approval from a director. [leave_policy.md]

rows.question: Which days am I expected to work from the office?

rows.question: How much is the home office stipend?
rows.answer: New employees receive a one-time home office stipend of 30,000 INR. [remote_work_policy.md]

rows.question: How much internet cost does the company reimburse per month?
rows.answer: Northwind also reimburses internet costs of up to 1,000 INR per month against a bill. [remote_work_policy.md]

rows.question: For how many days a year can I work from another country?
rows.answer: Employees may work from another country for up to 20 days per calendar year. [remote_work_policy.md]

rows.question: How quickly must I report a phishing email?
rows.answer: Suspected phishing emails must be reported to security@northwind.example within 1 hour of receipt. [it_security_policy.md]

rows.question: How soon must I report a lost laptop?
rows.answer: A lost or stolen device must be reported to the IT helpdesk within 2 hours. [it_security_policy.md]

rows.question: Are USB storage devices allowed?
rows.answer: USB storage devices are blocked by default. [it_security_policy.md]

rows.question: How often are system access rights reviewed?

rows.question: Within how many days must I submit an expense claim?
rows.answer: Expense claims must be submitted within 30 days of the expense date. [expense_policy.md]

rows.question: Above what amount do I need a receipt?
rows.answer: Receipts are required for any single expense above 500 INR. [expense_policy.md]

rows.question: Up to what amount can my manager approve an expense claim?
rows.answer: Managers can approve claims up to 25,000 INR. [expense_policy.md]

rows.question: What is the hotel cap per night in metro cities?
rows.answer: Hotel stays are capped at 7,000 INR per night in metro cities. [expense_policy.md]

rows.question: What is the domestic meal allowance per day?
rows.answer: The domestic meal allowance is 1,500 INR per day. [expense_policy.md]

rows.question: Which class should I book for flights shorter than 6 hours?
rows.answer: Flights shorter than 6 hours must be booked in economy class. [expense_policy.md]
